name: Advanced Laboratory in Bioelectronics & Biosensing
description: Basic concepts of medical instrumentation – terminology of medical devices, medical instrumentation systems, operating modes and classification of biomedical instruments, general static and dynamic characteristics. Basic transducers and their principles: resistive sensors, inductive sensors, capacitive sensors, piezoelectric sensors, optical, impedance and surface acoustic wave transducers. Origin and measurement of biopotentials: excitable cells, origins of ECG, EMG, EEG, biopotential electrode and its effect, equivalent circuit model. Operational amplifiers and signal processing: basic amplifier design, differential amplifiers, filters, ADC conversion. Introduction to chemical biosensors and biomolecules: Biosensor classification, main elements in biosensors, DNA, enzyme, antibody, antigen, protein, peptide, aptamer, lateral flow assay based kits. Amplification and detection techniques: amplification techniques (PCR), ELISA (enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay), fluorescence spectroscopy, UV-vis absorption and emission, surface plasmon resonance. Electrochemical cells and measurement techniques: voltammetry and amperometry, immobilized enzyme-electrodes, impedance spectroscopy, fluorescence and colorimetric sensors.
